summary: Configured node1 as an NFSv4.2 server and mounted its shared export persistently on node2 and node3. Shared identity, ownership, permissions, cross-client visibility, and recovery survived sequential restarts of all three nodes.
actions_performed: Created sharedops with UID/GID 4200 on all nodes.
Exported /srv/nfs/shared from node1 to only 10.100.36.11 and 10.100.36.12.
Set /srv/nfs/shared ownership to sharedops:sharedops and mode 2770.
Mounted 10.100.36.10:/srv/nfs/shared at /mnt/shared using persistent NFSv4.2 fstab entries on both clients.
Verified bidirectional file visibility with retained UID/GID and modes.
Restarted node2, node3, and node1 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and full recovery after each.

evidence.requirement: NFSv4 server export and shared-directory configuration
evidence.summary: Shows active/enabled NFSv4 service, client-restricted exports, and /srv/nfs/shared owned by UID/GID 4200 with mode 2770.

evidence.requirement: sharedops identity UID/GID 4200 on all nodes
evidence.summary: Final direct output from every node reports sharedops as UID 4200 and GID 4200.

evidence.requirement: Persistent NFSv4 mounts on node2 and node3
evidence.summary: Both clients show /mnt/shared mounted from 10.100.36.10:/srv/nfs/shared with NFSv4.2 and matching persistent fstab entries.

evidence.requirement: Immediate cross-client visibility with retained ownership and permissions
evidence.summary: Each client directly observed files created by the other, including after the server restart; files retained sharedops ownership and modes 0640 or 0660.

evidence.requirement: Consistent final shared data on server and both clients
evidence.summary: All three nodes report the same six files, numeric ownership, modes, sizes, and SHA-256 hashes.
Captures healthy baseline boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered NFSv4 mount and data, and peer-visible post-restart write.
Captures healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement and disconnect, changed boot ID, recovered mount/data, and peer-visible post-restart write.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and NFS service recovery
evidence.summary: Captures healthy server baseline, reboot acknowledgement and disconnect, changed boot ID, restored service/listener/exports/data, and successful client I/O after recovery.
